requirements.requirement: The system must intercept every quality score computation request and route it through the caching service before execution.
The system must generate a deterministic cache key using the schema defined in EVAL-CACHE-S1 for every incoming request.
The system must check the cache store for an existing entry matching the generated cache key.
The system must return the cached result when a matching entry exists and is within TTL and version validity.
The system must treat a cache entry as invalid if its TTL has expired.
The system must treat a cache entry as invalid if its version does not match the current computation version.
The system must compute a new quality score when no valid cache entry is found.
The system must persist newly computed quality scores to the cache using the generated cache key.
The system must store TTL and version metadata alongside each cached entry.
The system must return the newly computed result to the caller after writing it to the cache.
The system must ensure that cache read and write operations follow the persistence patterns established in machine_brain.py.
The system must support read-through caching behavior where cache miss triggers computation automatically.
The system must support write-through caching behavior where computed results are immediately written to cache before response.
The system must handle cache miss scenarios without increasing response latency beyond the baseline computation time.
The system must log whether each request resulted in a cache hit or miss for observability.
The system must handle cache read failures by proceeding with score computation and returning a valid result.
The system must handle cache write failures by returning the computed result without blocking the response.
The system must avoid writing duplicate cache entries for the same key within a single request lifecycle.
The system must ensure idempotent behavior such that repeated identical requests produce the same cache key and result.
The system must not return partially computed or incomplete cache entries under any condition.
